units.previous_finding: F01: EN '* Go local' introduces Tour languages; DA '* Go lokalt' misleadingly suggests local/offline execution, conflating this page with welcome/4. Revise only the localized heading to communicate language availability while preserving Present structure.

F02: EN 'first parameter s of append is a slice of type T', next to signature func append(s []T, vs ...T) []T; DA 'en slice af typen T' wrongly suggests s has type T. Clarify that T is the element type and s has Go slice type []T, preserving protected signature.

F03: EN "A _goroutine_ is a lightweight thread managed by the Go runtime"; DA "En _goroutine_ er en letvægdstråd, der styres af Go-kørselsmiljøet." The technical noun "letvægdstråd" is an incorrect Danish compound spelling in the introductory definition. Correct the spelling/naturalness, preserving Go Present "_goroutine_" emphasis and original technical meaning.
